text: 4 stars. Keeping it. The space bar rattles. If you hit it with your thumb you get this clack clack, like a loose pen cap in a drawer. E repeats sometimes, like the word example becomes eexample and I have to backspace. Happens maybe once an afternoon. Always when I type fast and not looking. I paid $38. Keeping it anyway because of the switches, I asked the seller what the switches are, took them a week to respond. But I pried a keycap off to see what they were, brown tactiles, little bump under your finger and soft bottom out. Old membrane board feels like pressing wet cardboard, compared to this. My job is mostly email, 2-3 hours at a time. Wrists don't hurt when I finish. That mattered more than the rattle. Returning it would have meant paying postage and boxing it and waiting, not having a keyboard while waiting. Stays on desk, I put spacebar tap more towards middle now.
